title: What the gateway refuses, and with which status
lede: Every refusal has its own status and its own reason. A refused call never reaches the tool. Simulated; the staged events and the thresholds are the lab's own.

nodes.label: 401: bad signature, audience, expiry, act or proof

steps.title: The call arrives
steps.what: The BFF presents the delegated token to the gateway.

steps.title: Invalid token: 401
steps.what: A wrong audience, a bad signature, a missing act claim or a replayed DPoP proof is refused with 401.

steps.title: Not allowed: 403
steps.what: A token without the scope, a blocked query or state, or a raw user token forwarded without an exchange is refused with 403.

steps.title: Too many calls: 429
steps.what: A burst over the limit (lab-invented: 30 per minute) is refused with 429 and a retry-after.

steps.title: Cannot validate: 503
steps.what: When token validation cannot be reached the gateway fails closed.

steps.title: Token ok: ask Authorize
steps.what: A valid token still needs a policy decision before the tool runs.
